name: Live Projects Catalog
description: A collection of hands-on React-based programming projects from Project School, designed to enhance practical coding skills through real-world applications and exercises.

hasPart.name: Basic Android React-Native App with Google Login
hasPart.description: A simple and minimalistic Android app built with React-Native and Expo, featuring Google Sign-In, a basic home screen, a user profile page displaying the user's photo and name, and a logout button to return to the home screen.

hasPart.name: Interactive Power BI Bar Chart
hasPart.description: This project involves creating an interactive Power BI-style bar chart visual using React.js and Chart.js, where user data is segmented by age group with cross-filtering functionality.

hasPart.name: Activity Management Dashboard
hasPart.description: A robust React application featuring a dashboard with detailed insights into activity specifics, historical records, user claims, and rules, built with Material-UI for a modern UI.

hasPart.name: Construction Cost Calculator
hasPart.description: A user-friendly React application to estimate construction costs based on plot size, floors, construction type, and materials, using Formik and Yup for form management and validation.

hasPart.name: React Firebase Application with ML and Payments
hasPart.description: A React app utilizing Firebase for authentication and storage, Google Analytics for tracking, Google ML for classification, and Stripe for payments.

hasPart.name: Deploy Your React App to GoDaddy
hasPart.description: This task outlines the steps to deploy your React application to a GoDaddy hosting account, covering building the app, uploading files, and configuring the domain.

hasPart.name: Building a React App with Contentful Integration for Content Sharing
hasPart.description: A content-sharing app built with React and Contentful, allowing users to share various types of content with real-time updates and a responsive interface.

hasPart.name: Integrate Google Calendar API into a React Website
hasPart.description: A step-by-step guide to integrating the Google Calendar API into a React application for displaying and managing calendar events.

hasPart.name: Simple Business Website
hasPart.description: A React web application featuring a product catalog, contact form, and customer reviews section, built with reusable components and modern practices.

hasPart.name: Build a Portfolio Website with Admin Panel
hasPart.description: A portfolio website built with React, Express.js, and MongoDB, featuring an admin panel with JWT authentication for managing projects.

hasPart.name: VideoSense Live Monitoring
hasPart.description: A React-based web application for real-time monitoring of CCTV video feeds, supporting multiple streams with a user-friendly interface.

hasPart.name: Payroll Application Development
hasPart.description: A React and Node.js web platform for managing employee payment processing, tailored to a single country's tax laws with a dashboard and payroll form.

hasPart.name: Therapist Calendar App
hasPart.description: A responsive React calendar app for scheduling therapy appointments, featuring date and time selection, local storage, and email notifications.

hasPart.name: E-Commerce Store
hasPart.description: A simple React e-commerce store with product listings, a shopping cart, search and filter functionality, and a review system.

hasPart.name: QR & GPS Tracker
hasPart.description: A React web app combining QR code scanning and real-time geolocation tracking, ideal for navigation or event check-ins.

hasPart.name: ZipImage Extractor
hasPart.description: A React app that extracts images from uploaded .zip files and displays them in a grid with hover-to-enlarge functionality and a modal popup.

hasPart.name: English-Terms-Learning
hasPart.description: English Terms Learning App helps beginners improve vocabulary through quizzes, feedback, Firebase authentication, MongoDB storage, and customizable multiple-choice tests.
